d_avma_studycontent_data.potential_benefits: Investigational drug will be funded at no charge. Partial study funding; the study site will discuss what other services are covered at no cost if your pet is eligible.
d_avma_studycontent_data.inclusion_criteria: Dog is > 12 months of age  Dog weighs > 5kg  Dog has ECOG performance status less   Dog has stage 3 or stage 4 intranasal adenocarcinoma and is amenable to radiotherapy  Dog is able to tolerate multiple anesthesia events  No radiotherapy, chemotherapy, or surgical therapy prior to enrollment  No clinical significant cardiovascular arrhythmias
d_avma_studycontent_data.exclusion_criteria: Prior radiotherapy, chemotherapy, or surgical therapy  Intranasal adenocarcinoma that is NOT stage 3 or stage 4  Unable to handle multiple anesthesia events

d_sv_content.name: Clinical Trial for Canine Intranasal Adenocarcinoma
d_sv_content.description: A multicenter, randomized, double-masked, placebo-controlled clinical trial to evaluate a novel investigational product in dogs with stage 3 and stage 4 intranasal adenocarcinoma.
